name: Laikou Japan Sakura Serum 17ml
description:
Laikou Japan Sakura Serum – 17ml

🌸 Brightening | Anti-Aging | Deep Nourishment

Product Type: Facial Serum
Volume: 17ml
Origin: Japan

Key Ingredients & Benefits:

Sodium Hyaluronate: Boosts skin elasticity, hydrates, and works as an anti-wrinkle moisturizer.

Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C): Brightens skin, reduces freckles, and evens out skin tone.

Tremella Fuciformis Extract: Rich in antioxidants, deeply nourishes and protects skin from damage.

Prunus Mume Fruit Extract: Stimulates collagen production, reduces fine lines, and fights signs of aging.

Features:

🌸 Brightens dull skin & improves texture

🌸 Deeply hydrates and nourishes

🌸 Reduces wrinkles, fine lines & freckles

🌸 Promotes youthful, radiant skin

🌸 Lightweight serum, absorbs quickly

✅ Best For: Whitening, anti-wrinkle, anti-aging, skin brightening, hydration
✅ Suitable For: All skin types (daily use)
✅ Gender: Female
